description: This file contains shell functions and scripts to configure U-Boot environment settings on OpenWrt. It includes functions to add UCI configurations, manage UBI devices, MTD partitions, and MMC devices, as well as default environment setup for NAND UBI volumes.

methods.name: _ubootenv_add_uci_config
methods.description: Core function to add U-Boot environment configuration via UCI, parameterized by configuration type and device details.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_uci_config
methods.description: Wrapper to add 'ubootenv' configuration using the core function.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_app_config
methods.description: Adds configuration for U-Boot environment with specific device parameters, values stored in config files.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_mtd
methods.description: Adds U-Boot environment configuration for a specified MTD device.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_sys_mtd
methods.description: Adds system U-Boot environment configuration for a specified MTD device.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_mmc
methods.description: Adds U-Boot environment configuration for an MMC device.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_ubi_default
methods.description: Sets up default U-Boot environment for UBI volumes on NAND, referencing functions from nand.sh.
